title: A/R Collection: a column where every row is the same does not reorder
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has three overdue invoices on today's date, {Invoice-A}, {Invoice-B} and {Invoice-C}, all at {Location-A}; in number order they read A, B, C.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-39 Same Place; {Invoice-A} is S1-99, {Invoice-B} S1-100 and {Invoice-C} S1-101.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand {Customer-A}'s group.
  2. Click the "Location" header.
  3. Read the order of the three invoices.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the group shows the three invoices, each with Location {Location-A}.
  • Step 2: the Location column is marked as sorted, but nothing visibly moves inside the group: every row has the same value.
  • Step 3: the three invoices are ordered by number: {Invoice-A}, {Invoice-B}, {Invoice-C}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-E1: “A column where every row has the same value (for example Location when each customer has one location) shows no visible change; the tie-break (S2-R4) still applies.”
  • S2-R4: “ID and No. sort by number value: S1-99 before S1-100 before S1-101. The same number-aware order breaks ties in every sort.”
